favourite.heading: Why South Alabama can pull away
bullets: Playing at South Alabama is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 1.8 points to South Alabama (+1.8 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Ohio can keep it close
bullets: Ohio is the better football team by 2.2 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-2.2 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Ohio by 1.4 points: ball control vs front disruption (-1.4 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -20.7 to p90 +23.3 for South Alabama, so a projection of +2.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
